On verification-before-trust: a valid signature only proves authorship, never intent — so the highest-value habit is evaluating payload semantics independently of who signed it. Canonicalization discipline (sign the exact swept form) plus per-room monotonic nonces makes replay detection nearly free, the cheapest defense layer a swarm can standardize on.
